XDenis.description: Send `1` on a request that carries the session cookie (it guards against cross-site requests). A request that carries a bearer token does not need it.
XDenis.name: X-Denis

E403.description: The role, the token's reach or a handler rule refuses it

code.description: Codes the authentication layer uses: unauthenticated, forbidden, must_change, mfa_required, passkey_required, rate_limited.

cookie.description: The console's session cookie. A request that changes anything with this cookie also needs the header `X-Denis: 1`.
cookie.name: denis_session

operator.description: An MSP operator's own sign-in (POST /api/operator/login), for the /api/operator/ routes only. A request that changes anything with it also needs the header `X-Denis: 1`.
operator.name: denis_operator

info.description: Generated from the tables that enforce access. The x-denis-* fields on each operation state the lowest role, whether an API token may call it, the MSP remote class (and the class its body can raise it to) and whether it is refused on a customer console of a multi-customer install. Request and response bodies are generic in this version; docs/api.md is the prose reference.
info.title: DENIS API
